en: Sepia-toned photograph of a courtyard or garden beside a large brick building. On the left stands a lion statue on a rectangular pedestal near benches and shrubs along the wall. A path leads inward toward smaller buildings in the background. On the right side, at an iron gate, is a striped wooden guard box with a uniformed soldier wearing a helmet standing at attention beside it. A vertical metric ruler appears along the right edge of the image, suggesting archival measurement.
